'''Rywin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[tromonid]]s. Mere [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after a [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] expedition to the planet resulted in the discovery of the [[Species/Legends|species]], they had infested five other planets due to their high [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduction]] rate.<ref name="BT" />
